from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Financing cash inflow data from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the report")
    financing_cash_inflow_total: float | None = Field(description="Total cash inflows from financing activities (筹资活动现金流入小计)")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the financing cash inflow value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flows: list[CompanyFinancingCashFlow]
